breakdown.description: The inward hole pressure is reversed to an outward traction by changing the sign relative to the solid normal
breakdown.reason: The incomplete prompt incorrectly defined the inward pressure with an outward-acting traction vector (`t = +p*n`). The agent correctly fixed this by specifying that the inward pressure is defined by `t = -p*n where n is the outward normal of the solid`, which aligns perfectly with the ground truth.
